story_type: hypersonic rocket sled filmed by a high speed camera
hook: This sled is moving at more than a mile per second.
narration: This sled is moving at more than a mile per second.
The camera runs so fast that this whole clip covers less than one hundredth of a second.
A rocket motor shoves the sled down a single steel rail at the Holloman High Speed Test Track in New Mexico.
On this run in July twenty twenty one, it hit fifty three hundred feet per second.
outcome: Then the team recovered the sled for the Hypersonic Sled Recovery effort.

location_card.place: Holloman Air Force Base, New Mexico

title: Rocket sled at a mile per second
description:
A hypersonic sled travels 5,300 feet per second on a monorail at the Arnold Engineering Development Complex High Speed Test Track at Holloman Air Force Base, New Mexico, on July 21, 2021.

Footage: U.S. Air Force video by Raquel L. March, Arnold Engineering Development Complex, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/819421/holloman-high-speed-test-track-completes-recovery-mission-hypersonic-speed
